reason: I already threw away most of the PRs background agents opened for us, and a pre-alpha tool from one developer doesn't change what the agent writes. Maybe I'd poke at the free self-hosted version on a slow Friday, but I'm not paying $99 a month for it.
objection: The morning PRs will still be junk I have to review and bin. Tests passing doesn't mean the code is something I'd merge, and setting up a Host and flows is more work on top.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that a team like mine actually merges most of the overnight PRs without rewriting them, for example a real merge rate over a few weeks.
